risks.title: Financial losses and impairments
risks.score_rationale: The company reported a net loss of $957 million in 2025, including $485 million in goodwill impairments and $317 million in asset impairments, indicating a significant deterioration in asset value.

risks.title: Product recalls and operational disruptions
risks.score_rationale: The Novum IQ LVP pump was recalled as Class I in July 2025, resulting in a halt of distribution in the United States and Canada. Hurricane Helene also caused significant damage and changes in customer clinical practices, reducing demand for IV solutions.

risks.title: Natural disaster risks
risks.score_rationale: Hurricane Helene in September 2024 damaged the North Cove facility in North Carolina and caused supply chain disruptions. Customers adopted fluid conservation practices with permanent clinical modifications, reducing demand.

risks.title: Deterioration of operational profitability
risks.score_rationale: Operating income shifted from $14 million in profit in 2024 to a loss of $308 million in 2025, reflecting the cumulative impact of product recalls, impairments, and hurricane-related disruptions.

risks.title: Regulatory and compliance risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict FDA and healthcare industry regulations, with Class I recall classifications for infusion pumps and regulatory approval requirements for corrective actions.

risks.title: Competitive risks
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive sector with available alternatives such as the Spectrum IQ pump as a replacement option for customers affected by Novum LVP recalls.
